summary.one_liner: Apache Spark is a unified analytics engine for large-scale data processing, offering high-level APIs in Scala, Java, Python, and R (R deprecated).
summary.what_it_does: Provides an optimized engine for general computation graphs used in data analysis. It includes higher-level tools: Spark SQL for SQL and DataFrames, pandas API on Spark for pandas workloads, MLlib for machine learning, GraphX for graph processing, and Structured Streaming for stream processing. The README covers building with Maven, starting interactive Scala and Python shells (bin/spark-shell, bin/pyspark), running bundled examples via bin/run-example, and running tests with dev/run-tests. It also notes that the build must match the Hadoop version of the target cluster. The README itself is a short setup guide; full documentation is on the project site.
use_cases: running SQL and DataFrame queries on big data
running pandas workloads at cluster scale
notable: Single engine covering SQL, pandas API, MLlib, GraphX, and streaming
Interactive Scala and Python shells for quick start
Can run locally with configurable threads or submit to Spark, YARN, or Kubernetes clusters
Bundled example programs runnable via run-example
caveats: Build must match the Hadoop version of the target cluster
R API is marked deprecated in the README
README is a basic setup guide; detailed docs live on the external project site
